ValidationRule.description: VR-OPP-02: Blocks 9-Lost and 5-Won without Loss/Win notes of at least 5 characters. Also requires Loss Reason on 9-Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '9-Lost'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Loss_Reason__c)), ISBLANK(Loss_Notes__c), LEN(Loss_Notes__c) < 50 ) ), AND( NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5-Won'), NOT(ISBLANK(Loss_Notes__c)), LEN(Loss_Notes__c) < 50 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Win/Loss notes must be at least 5 characters. For Lost deals, a Loss Reason is also required.
